g.text: WRITE example — frame_data to channel RAM
SLOT_SAMPLES=1024, SLOT_COUNT=4, ROWS=128. Example: wr_slot=2, wr_offset=13, write_fire=1.
One valid frame contains one simultaneous IQ16 sample from each channel.

div.div:
Address calculation for every channel:
lane = wr_offset mod 8 = 13 mod 8 = 5
address = wr_slot * ROWS + floor(wr_offset / 8) = 2 * 128 + 1 = 257

g.text: At edge N: write-port registers capture the frame component, address and enable.
At edge N+1: ram_write_proc commits A13/B13/C13/D13 into lane 5, address 257 of their respective banks.
Frame/sample numbers here are offsets within slot 2, not acquisition timestamps. RAM content is stored as full IQ16.
